---
title: Quality assurance
order: 50
---

It should be easy to do the right thing, and easy to spot if the wrong thing has been done.

This can be done by:

- multiple modes of checking,
- not leaving checking until the end,
- when possible, discussing within a team and providing enough feedback so that you don't go down dead ends too often,
- discussing ethics and data hazards.

## QA activities

- Peer review,
- Code review,
- Ethics discussions,
- Pair programming,
